question_text: Which of the following is the most correct statement in the light of the passage? You should highlight and summarize the information given in the chart. 10  Watching TV  Playing cards  Drawing  Others
answer_pointer: 183 Last week I enjoyed the marriage ceremony of my elder sister. The marriage was solemnized at our local community centre. A nicely decorated gate was made. The whole centre was decorated nicely with colourful lights, poster and balloons. More than two hundred guests were invited there. The guests started coming after sunset sharp. I put an my new fashionable dress. My friends appreciated me much in my dress. I along with my father and friends stood at the gate to welcome the guests. The guests of bridegroom also came in time. At a point the community centre turned into a gettogether centre. All of the guests exchanged their greetings with others. My parents were so much busy with the guests. I was also busy with my friends. The guests took their seats accordingly and had delicious foods such as pollao, birani, white rich with beef, mutton, chicken and so on, The most attraction was the sweet batel leaves. The guests had brought a lot of valuable gifts for the bride and bride-groom. My dear ones and relatives also helped my parents arranging the marriage ceremony. I had made much fun of the bride-groom. At the end of the ceremony all the guests left the place thanking my parents and appreciated them for a nice arrangement. May parents also thanked them for attending the ceremony. I enjoyed the wedding ceremony most.  Title : A memorable day in my life.
